fold_selection_rule: Only source table-region tasks 0/1 have a redundant audited geometry; leaving either out preserves all four geometries. Previously exposed source-internal probes, never sealed held-out tasks.

source_objectives.B_fomaml: One SGD support step on disposable Policy, query gradient pulled back through original contextual generator; no second-order derivative.
source_objectives.C_pooled_bc: Ordinary unadapted pooled BC on the same support/query batches, averaged before a generator update; no meta objective.
source_objectives.A_original: No source update; instantiate from paired untrained generator.

budget_matching.reason: B alone updates disposable inner Policies. These are counted separately; no exact wall-clock/FLOP or total parameter-write equivalence is claimed.

query_gate: For each fold, create/read probe meta_query only after all 3 seeds x 3 arms have completed all 500 support updates. No query selects checkpoints or stopping.
sampling: With-replacement uniform window sampling; B/C share identical source batches; A/B/C use identical probe adaptation window IDs. Num_workers=0.
optimizer: Adam betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0; source inner is SGD without momentum; norms clipped at 1.0.
loss: Uniform seven-dimensional valid-step MSE; uint8 RGB/255; no jitter, augmentation, phase or gripper reweighting.
stopping: Fixed budgets only. Abort on role/hash/budget mismatch, nonfinite outputs/gradients or resource gate failure; preserve partial attempts; no efficacy-based early stopping or retry tuning.
statistics: Report each seed and fold, paired B-A/B-C endpoint differences and descriptive learning curves; no significance claim, no unseen-transfer claim, no candidate acceptance.
